hook: The recipe is right. The oil is why it still tastes wrong.

onCreative.cover: The recipe is right. The oil is why it still tastes wrong.
onCreative.endFrame: Filtered Groundnut Oil — the one swap the recipe never mentioned.

scenes.visual: A dog-eared recipe card on the counter, oil bottle just out of frame.
scenes.voiceover: You've made this a hundred times. It still doesn't taste like hers.
scenes.onScreenText: The recipe is right. The oil is why it still tastes wrong.

scenes.visual: Pour shot, then the same dish finished two ways side by side.
scenes.voiceover: The recipe never names the oil. It just assumes any bottle does the same job.

scenes.visual: Final plated shot, pack beside the dish.
scenes.voiceover: One swap. Same recipe. Finally tastes like it should.

captions.copy: It's the exact recipe she wrote down. The only thing that never made it onto the card was which oil to use.
You've followed this recipe exactly for years. The one ingredient it never specified is the one that changes everything.
The recipe was never missing a step. It was missing an oil.
